preserved_failure: Original three traces reproduced all physical fields exactly, but their exported local-equation checks did not corroborate closure. All original results and failed checks remain unchanged.
identified_source_defect: model.py adds the e91 warm-sea land humidity-relaxation rate to lamE and uses a marine-humidity target in solve_moisture. The solver checks lamE*(target-W)+land_source, while the model's exported E on land contains only land_source. The subsequent budget diagnostic therefore omits the signed land marine-relaxation term. Its normalization must also use the solver's total net source, including drying/import, rather than surface E alone.
budget_amendment: Exactly THREE additional replays of the same three original parameter/region cases, to capture the omitted forcing from actual solve_moisture arguments and verify it. Six instrumented integrations total across the original plan and this explicit follow-up. No new setting, search, target or climate selection. Do not extend further under this amendment.
method: A process-local wrapper around solve_moisture calls the unchanged solver, records lamE*(ocean_water-result.water)*86400 on scored LAND cells, plus its exact net source and returned global residual certificate. For this frozen r58 ocean_sink=1, so lamE is unchanged by ocean_rate within the solver; assert that condition. No physics file, input array or result is modified. Restore the original function afterward.
controls: Three full physical monthly T/P/E/W/u/v fields and all original raw trace P/E/W/u/v arrays must reproduce the completed counterparts exactly. Existing exported budget arrays must also match the original packet. Join captured calls to trace days before weighting. Every strict numerical certificate must pass.
checks: Independently add the captured signed marine term to the original component sum and stored residual, accounting only for float32 export rounding. Normalize by max(rain+abs(actual solver net source),0.1), matching solve_moisture. Check against unchanged0.01 tolerance and the solver's returned global maximum; never infer the marine term by subtracting residual. Compare old/corrected diagnostics and retain instantaneous absolute residuals before monthly aggregation.
limits: Correcting bookkeeping does not improve the simulated climate. e91 is a modeled onshore marine-humidity relaxation, potentially a source OR sink, not land evaporation. The selected transport is still stationary concentration form; no conservative global/boundary-flux or observed attribution claim. Monsoon drying remains a subset of column drying.
core_patch: Defer any edit to rotclimate/model.py until the active W18c campaign is closed, because its physical-source inventory is frozen. The corrected external diagnostic and a regression test can establish the exact future bookkeeping patch without changing the active model.
